concerns.text: The specification defines functional requirements (FR‑001 … FR‑007) but provides no Success Criteria (SC) section with measurable, observable outcomes. Without SCs such as “p‑value for perseverative errors ≤ 0.05 after Bonferroni correction” or “runtime warning logged if wall‑clock time > 6 h”, implementers cannot determine when the system meets the project goals. Add a clearly measurable SC list that ties each primary FR to a quantitative threshold or observable artifact.
